speaker: james_burbage
text: You will hear it from me, and you will hear it once. Allen was civil. He named four-and-twenty pound a year. We pay fourteen.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Four-and-twenty against fourteen. I start a sentence once. I am not calling that a bargain.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Four-and-twenty is a number. Fourteen is a number. Say the length, James.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Two years less a month, till the lease falls in. There is a clause about the house after five years. He would not explain it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then price the timber before you pull the house down. Will, the curse was the part my brother asked of thee. Thou art the man he named.

speaker: james_burbage
text: I'll pull the house down before I pay a man to read me his own clause. The timber can be asked by someone who is not cursing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have never seen Allen. I am not cursing a man I have not seen. I have a king coming.

speaker: john_heminges
text: A king is not on this sheet. This sheet is the lease, and nothing on it is agreed.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tell him it's long. The king, I mean. I am not offering him a term.

speaker: james_burbage
text: A long king buys me no year. I am not signing a figure I cannot read.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then we are where we were. Four-and-twenty, fourteen, two years less a month, and a clause unread.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And the curse not said to his face. That is the part that was asked of thee, Will. Thou hast done it by not doing it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have done nothing. Nothing is agreed. Not the timber. Not the term. Not a word to Allen.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good. I will not write a figure we have not taken. The afternoon is the comedy. You are Navarre, Will. The lease is not in the book.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Play the comedy. The house stands this week because the doors open, not because Allen has been answered.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I will take a comedy I know. I will not carry an unread clause into the yard as if it were news we had settled.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then carry nothing. Thou hast a king in a chamber, Will, and Navarre at two. Do not mix the purses.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. The king is long, and he is not today's part. Today's part is the oath and the park.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then say the lease back, so the room has one hearing of it. Four-and-twenty. Fourteen. Nothing agreed.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Four-and-twenty pound a year, where we pay fourteen. Two years less a month. A clause unread. Nothing is agreed.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Heard. I am not staying to invent a bargain. The flag can go up.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Up with it. I want the play more than I want a second total.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And thou wilt tell him, if he comes, that the king is long. Not that we have yielded.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: If he comes. I have not seen him. I will not yield what we have not even priced.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The sentence is finished. Nothing is agreed. Go and be Navarre.
